site.title: How this site works
site.intro: This site is its own case study. No magic, just decisions you can poke at:

items.frontend: Next.js 15 (App Router) + React Three Fiber: the hero suslik is thousands of particles in a single draw call, morphing into persona glyphs and scattering away from your finger. Custom shader, zero prebuilt 3D assets.
items.hub: The backend is suslicke-hub: FastAPI + an aiogram bot on my own VPS. The shirt QR points at /qr, and I change campaigns and config straight from Telegram.
items.fallback: An nginx fallback: if the hub goes down, nginx answers with the redirect itself, so the shirt QR can't die as long as nginx is alive.
items.counter: The visit counter is my own Postgres table, no cookies: a daily hash instead of tracking. PostHog runs only with consent.

privacy.metaDescription: What suslicke.com collects: a first-party cookieless counter always, and PostHog, Google Analytics and Yandex Metrica with Webvisor only after consent.
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This is the personal site of Andrei Pustovoi. All I need is modest analytics: to understand where people come from and what they read. Below is an honest description of what is collected and when.

firstParty.title: First-party counter (always on)
firstParty.body: The site sends an anonymous hit to its own server: the page, the language, the traffic source (UTM tags). No cookies, no identifiers, no visitor profile. This is the only data collection before your decision in the consent banner.

consent.title: Third-party analytics: only after consent
consent.body: Until you press the accept button in the banner, no third-party script is loaded and no request leaves for any third-party service. The decision is stored in your browser (localStorage, key sl_consent); withdrawing it is as easy as granting: use the button below, or clear the site data.

posthog.title: PostHog (EU)
posthog.body: Product analytics: page views, clicks, session recordings. The data is processed on PostHog servers in the European Union.

ga.title: Google Analytics
ga.body: Google web analytics (GA4): visits, traffic sources, events. Loads only after consent.

metrika.title: Yandex Metrica and Webvisor
metrika.body: Yandex web analytics: visits, sources, click maps. Webvisor is enabled: it records session activity (mouse movement, scrolling, clicks). The Metrica script loads only after consent, so no recording happens before it.

processors.title: Data processors
processors.body: PostHog Inc., Google (Google Analytics) and Yandex (Yandex Metrica) process the analytics data on my behalf as processors. I do not sell the data or share it with anyone else.

contact.title: Questions
contact.body: Write to admin@suslicketeam.com if you want to clarify anything or ask for your data to be deleted.

withdraw.note: Consent to third-party analytics is currently granted. After withdrawal the page reloads and the third-party scripts stop loading.
